name: Sitowise Group Oyj
summary: Sitowise Group Oyj, founded in 2016 and based in Espoo, Finland, delivers a wide array of specialized services across the built environment, infrastructure, and digital technology sectors. Serving both public and private clients, their operations extend throughout Finland, Sweden, and internationally, covering structural, HVAC, and electrical engineering, energy efficiency consulting, road and railway planning, geological surveys, and smart data management for urban development and transport infrastructure projects.
